Critically, the animal_pose_auditor reports a HIGH artifact risk level with ~80% of keypoints having low confidence (<0.5), indicating widespread structural uncertainty in the limbs and face of the hybrid. This suggests the model struggled to resolve the anatomy of this impossible creature. Additionally, the motorcycles show fusion artifacts at the handlebars and front wheels (severity 2), and the spatial relationships ('under') are consistently misinterpreted as 'in front of', indicating a lack of 3D scene understanding. The texture of the pig spots appears airbrushed/painted rather than natural.

High pose estimation uncertainty (80% low-confidence keypoints) indicating structural anomalies in the hybrid animal
